.dsh/profiles/headless/cordis.patch.yml:
- config:
    providers:
      cranibox:
        api: openai-completions
        apiKeyEnv: CRANIBOX_GATEWAY_KEY
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:3424/v1
        displayName: Cranibox
        models: []
      cranibox-responses:
        api: openai-responses
        apiKeyEnv: CRANIBOX_GATEWAY_KEY
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:3424/v1
        displayName: Cranibox
        models: []
      cranibox-anthropic:
        api: anthropic-messages
        apiKeyEnv: CRANIBOX_GATEWAY_KEY
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:3424
        displayName: Cranibox
        models: []
  id: llm-pi-ai
- config:
    model: test/model
    provider: cranibox
  id: agent-default-model
